newsitem.title: USA: Cyrix chip shipments lift Q1 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Cyrix chip shipments lift Q1 earnings.

text.p: Cyrix Corp On Wednesday attributed a jump in first quarter earnings to strong customer acceptance of its microprocessors, higher gross margins and enhanced manufacturing efficiencies.

"Stronger than planned unit shipment performance at the end of the quarter helped us to exceed our profit goals," said said Jay Swent, Cyrix chief financial officer and acting chief executive officer.
Earlier, the firm said net income for the first quarter was $6.6 million, or $0.33 per share up from $2.0 million or $0.10 per share a year ago.
The company said it remains on target to begin initial production shipments of its M2 chip in June, with a full production ramp-up in the third quarter.
M2 is compatible with Intel Corp's MMX multimedia architecture, Cyrix said.
Cyrix Corp makes chips for the desktop personal computers.
